previous_lineage: I3.12 (semantic relation ablation, closed at ba07512)
scientific_question: Can the metacognitive architecture operate over actually retrieved evidence, and where does performance degrade in the longer causal chain from retrieval through semantic extraction through epistemic reasoning through routing through policy?
motivation: I3.12 established that R1 remains beneficial despite semantic extraction errors on controlled synthetic text. I3.13 tests whether this survives the transition from generated evidence to retrieved real-world document passages, introducing a new upstream failure channel: retrieval error.

new_components.document_corpus: Frozen corpus of real document passages with evaluator-side ground truth
new_components.i3_13_task_generator: Generates tasks with hypotheses and evidence from real passages
new_components.i3_13_runner: Runs the full causal chain experiment

experiment_design.type: Multi-condition experiment with causal chain tracking

retrieval_conditions.R0_ORACLE: All required passages supplied directly (no retrieval needed)
retrieval_conditions.R1_REAL: BM25 retriever supplies top-k passages (may miss relevant, include irrelevant)
retrieval_conditions.R2_DISTRACTORS: BM25 retriever + guaranteed relevant + additional distractor passages

experiment_design.full_factorial: 3 retrieval conditions x 6 representations = 18 arms (if budget permits)

failure_channels: RETRIEVAL_ERROR: needed evidence was never retrieved
SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION_ERROR: needed evidence was retrieved but classified incorrectly
EPISTEMIC_ERROR: relations correct but MDSG/T2 was wrong
ROUTING_ERROR: epistemic state correct but representation routing was wrong
POLICY_ERROR: everything upstream correct but LLM policy failed

corpus_design.source: Frozen document corpus with recoverable ground truth
requirements: Each task has competing hypotheses where correct evidence exists in the corpus
Evaluator knows which passages are required for each task
Genuine retrieval recall can be calculated
Passages contain real-world language (not controlled templates)

per_task_telemetry.failure_attribution: RETRIEVAL_ERROR | SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION | EPISTEMIC_ERROR | ROUTING_ERROR | POLICY_ERROR | NO_ERROR

safety_metrics.trajectory_t2_precision: TP / (TP + FP) using trajectory-level T2 (not initial-snapshot)
safety_metrics.rescue_break_ratio: R1 rescues / R1 breaks vs A1

interpretation_tree.if_passes_and_r1_above_a1: Architecture operates over retrieved evidence; proceed to uncertainty-aware relations (I3.14)
interpretation_tree.if_fails_due_to_retrieval: Retrieval is the bottleneck; improve retriever before testing semantic robustness
interpretation_tree.if_fails_due_to_semantic: Semantic extraction on real text is the bottleneck; build extractor v3 with cost-sensitive loss
interpretation_tree.if_fails_due_to_t2: Epistemic graph uncertainty is the bottleneck; build uncertainty-aware T2
interpretation_tree.if_fails_due_to_policy: Base policy is the bottleneck; improve prompts or model

progression.I3.12: Can semantic noise enter the architecture? YES
progression.I3.13: Can the architecture operate over actually retrieved evidence?
progression.I3.15: Can the system generalize across domains/models?
